The Defective Detective — Album 3: Serah Contemplates

Serah Solves

"Serah Solves Apparently everything"

[Verse] Phone rings once Then twice Then six

Foxxie grins, “The plug is working.”

Coda checks the website stats

Then slowly stops smirking

I look outside

There’s a line

Around the block

And down the street

I look at Coda

She looks at me

“Okay.”

“That might be on me.”

[Pre-Chorus] I said

“Free consultation For the first three.”

Coda says,

“I may have missed the three.”

Silence

Then the phone rings again

[Chorus] Serah Solves Apparently everything Lost loves Bad jobs Why your neighbor cannot sing

Serah Solves Take a number Take a seat If your problem needs a detective

Please make sure it’s actually a problem first

[Verse] Case one says,

“Why am I still single?”

Denied

Case two asks,

“Where does my high school crush live now?”

Absolutely not

Case three says,

“I got fired from work.”

“Why?”

“I kept bringing home office supplies.”

“That’s theft.”

“I prefer recycling.”

Next

[Pre-Chorus] “Can the dead come back?”

Coda looks up

Nessa stops

Foxxie raises one brow

I say,

“That depends entirely On why you are asking that question.”

The client says,

“My landlord.”

“No.”

[Chorus] Serah Solves Apparently everything Missing pets Haunted locks Who keeps stealing wedding rings

Serah Solves Take a number Join the queue If you need us finding something

There’s a terrifying chance we actually do

[Verse] Kamira files the weirdest ones

Foxxie names each folder twice

Nessa makes a sorting system

Coda says, “This interface is nice.”

Andy brings the coffee out

Somebody tips him

Good

I point at the jar

“That goes toward electricity.”

Everyone nods

Finally

Progress

[Bridge] Then an old Mothman steps inside

Dusty coat Bent wings Tired eyes

Runs an antique shop downtown

Says something valuable disappeared

No broken lock

No shattered glass

No camera feed that clearly lasts

But one witness saw someone leave

Red hair

Horns

Smoking

I stop

[Pre-Chorus] Kamira lowers the file

Coda looks up

Nessa goes still

Andy whispers,

“Lyra?”

I say,

“Maybe.”

Then look at the client

“What was stolen?”

[Chorus] Serah Solves Now we have something real Antique gone No clear trace No clean motive we can feel

Serah Solves Red hair Horns Smoke outside

One more shadow in the city

One more reason not to let this slide

[Verse] The Mothman says,

“It was old.”

“How old?”

“Older than me.”

“That is not helpful.”

“It was a box.”

“What kind?”

“One nobody should open.”

Everyone looks at me

I hate when they do that

I rub my eyes

“Fine.”

[Pre-Chorus] Then I hold up one finger

“Before we proceed.”

Client waits

I point at the bills

“Downpayment.”

He blinks

“For the case?”

“For the case.”

“And the electric bill.”

“And the rent.”

[Chorus] Serah Solves No more charity today Truth is noble Truth is sacred

Truth still has utilities to pay

Serah Solves Take the case Take the cash Take the lead

If a red-haired horned smoker Took the thing

That’s all the reason that I need

[Final Chorus] Serah Solves Phones are ringing off the wall Foxxie plugs us Coda codes us

Now apparently we take them all

Serah Solves Not every case Not every plea

But if something smells like trouble

Put the file in front of me

Serah Solves One weird office One growing line

One missing family still comes first

But other mysteries can wait in line

[Outro] Kamira stamps the folder

Coda opens a fresh tab

Nessa grabs a scanner

Andy hands me coffee

Foxxie leans toward the mic

“Another case?”

I look at the Mothman

Then at the bills

Then at the note

Red hair

Horns

Smoke

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“Downpayment first.”

“Then we solve it.”
